Name: Friendship Booster
Author: Hills71
TagLine: Making friends is hard. This mod makes it easier. Every night, it gives a configurable boost to friendship to all of the NPCs you talked to during the day.
Description:
Making friends is hard. This mod makes it easier. Every night, it gives a configurable boost to friendship to all of the NPCs you talked to during the day.

This is just a personal mod I made for my playthrough. With fantastic mods like Ridgeside Village and SVE, I was overwhelmed with the number of NPCs and wanted a little boost to help me complete their storylines without feeling drained from having to talk/gift every NPC every day.

How it works: Every night when you sleep, the mod detects which NPCs you talked to during the day and add friendship points to them. The bonus defaults to an extra 50 friendship points but you can use the config file if you want more.

One caveat: The mod stops around 8 hearts. This was a quick mod I made and I didn't want to delve into the friendship ranks past 8 on dating vs non-dating NPCs so I made it just stop at 8. So after that, you are on your own.

Compatibility: It should work for all vanilla and custom NPCs without any problems.
